notes: Online ARPGs (Path of Exile 1 and 2, Diablo III/IV, Diablo II: Resurrected, Torchlight: Infinite, Last Epoch, Grim Dawn) all go to adventure; Online Worlds is kept for persistent shared worlds.

Retro is by original release before about 2006 for offline games. Remakes and remasters go by genre (Silent Hill 2 2024, Resident Evil 2/3/4 remakes, Tomb Raider I-III Remastered, Kingdom Hearts HD, Diablo II: Resurrected).

Older games with a living online or competitive scene stay in their genre, not retro: old MMOs (World of Warcraft, Tibia, Lineage II, Ragnarok, MU, FFXI), StarCraft, Warcraft III, Age of Empires II/III, Heroes III, Smash Melee, Marvel vs. Capcom 2, Counter-Strike: Source.
Twitch's 'Call of Duty' (1494) is nominally the 2003 original, but I read it as a generic franchise category and put it in shooters rather than retro.
Tabletop roleplay (Dungeons & Dragons, Tabletop RPGs) goes to roleplay with the GTA RP servers. Board Games, Warhammer and Tabletop Simulator go to strategy.
GTA III, Vice City and San Andreas are retro by release date, even though San Andreas multiplayer RP exists. GTA IV, Black Russia and NEXTRP go to roleplay.

Gacha RPGs (Genshin, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Wuthering Waves, NIKKE, Epic Seven, Summoners War, Raid) go to adventure. Tactics or card gachas (Arknights, Girls' Frontline 2) go to strategy, fighting gachas (Contest of Champions, Dragon Ball Legends) to fighting, and Umamusume to cozy.
Looter, hero and vehicle-combat shooters are shooters: Destiny 2, Warframe, The Division 2, Helldivers 2, The First Descendant, World of Warships, Mir Korabley, War Robots, Crossout, MechWarrior 5.
Melee battle royales (NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, My Hero Ultra Rumble) go to arenas, not shooters. Fantasy extraction crawlers (Dark and Darker, Mistfall Hunter) go to adventure.
Rhythm games go to creative as music performance: osu!, Beat Saber, Clone Hero, and also Geometry Dash. Rage platformers (Jump King, Pogostuck) go to adventure.
Kart racers (Mario Kart World, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds) go to sports with racing, not cozy.

Survival-crafting online games (Once Human, Dune: Awakening, Palworld) go to survival. Fallout 76, Star Citizen, EVE Online and Elite: Dangerous go to Online Worlds. Palia goes to cozy. City builders (Anno 117, Planet Zoo 2, Transport Fever 3) go to sandbox; 4X and RTS go to strategy.

Pokémon Champions (competitive battling) goes to strategy. Pokémon GO and Pokopia go to cozy. Mainline Pokémon from Platinum (2008) onward goes to adventure; FireRed/LeafGreen and Emerald go to retro.

Gambling-adjacent categories are deliberately left unassigned for a founder call: Casino Simulator, Casino Simulator 2024 and Tournament Poker. Crypto is too, as speculation streams. If the founder agrees, they should be excluded like Slots and Poker.

Two Twitch categories are both named 'Resident Evil' (492035, 932115604), and I can't tell which release each one is, so both go to survival. Names keep Twitch's exact text, including the stray spaces in ' SEKIRO: SHADOWS DIE TWICE' and 'Finals Week '.
